case: Workshop boat-packing: repeated violet pigment on matte linen and glossy lacquer, ochre ceramic accent, ivory neutral support, localized woven stripes.
reference_scope: Visible face and hair appearance only; actual identity, personality and biography unestablished.
palette_ownership: Agent-selected condition; the palette is not a requester lock.

expected_visible_relations.property: same aubergine-violet local pigment on matte woven linen versus glossy lacquered wood
expected_visible_relations.confounding_alternative: Global violet color cast or one generic gloss/material applied to both surfaces
expected_visible_relations.pixel_pass_criteria: Both distinct objects are visible with violet body pigment; linen has diffuse folds/fibers and hull has smooth elongated reflective edge.

expected_visible_relations.property: ochre cup small accent and ivory shirt/cabin neutral support
expected_visible_relations.confounding_alternative: Ochre wash across skin/background or yellow lacquer replacing the violet hull
expected_visible_relations.pixel_pass_criteria: Ochre cup is identifiable as ceramic and occupies a smaller visible color area than the total violet apron/hull; ivory shirt/cabin remain pale neutral.

expected_visible_relations.property: violet/ivory thin stripes only on a woven mat, other test carriers solid
expected_visible_relations.confounding_alternative: Stripes spread onto apron/hull or disappear into generic tonal shading
expected_visible_relations.pixel_pass_criteria: A distinct striped woven mat is visible with at least three alternating stripe units; apron, hull and cup show continuous solid pigment.

expected_visible_relations.property: soft linen shading, bent lacquer reflection, rounded ceramic highlight, brushed steel neutral response
expected_visible_relations.confounding_alternative: Pigment mistaken for colored illumination, frame-wide grading or metallic sheen
expected_visible_relations.pixel_pass_criteria: At least linen and lacquer are perceptually distinct; cup has localized glaze shine; light surfaces and skin remain neutrally rendered.

expected_visible_relations.property: two support hands guide the hull into a separate fitted cradle with clearance
expected_visible_relations.confounding_alternative: Floating boat or hands merely posed beside a disconnected object
expected_visible_relations.pixel_pass_criteria: Both support hands belong to the subject and contact separate underside regions; visible cradle below the model explains transfer.

optional_data_test: After core freeze, record exposure, compatibility, adoption, literal evidence, complete opt-in obligation and pixel result for a genuinely suitable newly added profile/candidate. A mismatch is a coverage gap, never grounds to alter core locks.
predeclared_scene_review: Assess readable careful transfer and object/material hierarchy separately from fidelity and user acceptance.
